text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. So yesterday I watched this magic 
reveal video~ ...and you, like, make the 
coin disappear! You know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Riiiight?♡ Being able to do this in just 
one night, aren't I amazing~? Such a 
genius~♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What the heck, this isn't easy at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be... something like this, 
right! See, told ya!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No way, just from looking at it!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh! I want to try it too~! Pandora-san, 
how do you do it~?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, first hold the coin. Then apply 
pressure near your thumb like this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I see, right on the thuuummb!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oho! I did it! The coin has completely 
vanished~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you just crumpled it into a little 
ball! That doesn't count as erasing it!
